scope: public read-only Revolut and Revolut X documentation, web content, and open-source SDK evidence

findings.title: Polish BTC page mixes PLN market context with EUR conversion context
findings.surface: Revolut Poland BTC public price page
findings.claim: The same public page presents BTC/PLN market context while its converter and PLN-labelled conversion table use EUR.

causal_memory.surface_scope: Revolut Poland public crypto price pages
causal_memory.state_scope: route locale, heading currency, hero converter, conversion table, market statistics

user_control.user_effect: A visitor cannot reliably tell whether the entered amount and displayed conversion are denominated in PLN or EUR.

findings.minimal_fix: Derive route heading, hero converter, conversion table and links from one explicit currency context.
findings.regression_test: For each locale route, assert that heading, hero input, current rate, conversion table and generated links use the same quote currency.

findings.title: Solana withdrawal copy contradicts itself
findings.surface: Revolut Poland SOL/USD public conversion page
findings.claim: The page offers external Solana wallet transfer and then limits supported external wallets to Bitcoin and Ethereum only.

user_control.user_effect: A user cannot determine from the page whether SOL can be sent to an external wallet.

findings.minimal_fix: Replace the token-specific paragraph with capability data generated from the supported withdrawal asset matrix.
findings.regression_test: Render the page for every withdrawable token and assert that the token named in the sentence is present in the supported external-wallet set.

findings.title: SDK exposes Retry-After seconds as milliseconds
findings.claim: The SDK returns a numeric Retry-After header unchanged while its public contract documents the property in milliseconds.

user_control.user_effect: A consumer following the README can wait milliseconds instead of seconds and immediately repeat a rate-limited request.

findings.minimal_fix: Parse delay-seconds as seconds converted to milliseconds and support the HTTP-date form before constructing RateLimitError.
findings.regression_test: Assert Retry-After 2 becomes 2000 ms, a valid HTTP-date becomes a non-negative delay, and invalid values become undefined.

findings.title: Public market-data authentication contract is internally contradictory
findings.surface: Revolut X developer reference and official open-source reference
findings.claim: Official materials simultaneously describe public endpoints as unauthenticated, require custom headers for every request, and show Bearer-token curl examples.

causal_memory.state_scope: security scheme, endpoint auth, curl examples and error codes

user_control.user_effect: An integrator cannot determine whether public data needs no credentials, a Bearer token, or Ed25519 headers.

findings.minimal_fix: Set explicit no-auth security for public operations and remove both Bearer and custom-auth requirements from their examples.
findings.regression_test: Generate the reference from one OpenAPI contract and assert public operations have security disabled and no auth headers in curl samples.

findings.title: Node.js signing example uses an obsolete order path and body
findings.surface: Revolut X developer reference signing example
findings.claim: The Node.js example signs a path and payload that do not match the current order-placement contract.

causal_memory.state_scope: request path, symbol format and order body

user_control.user_effect: Copying the official example produces a signature over the wrong path and an invalid order payload.

findings.minimal_fix: Regenerate the Node.js example from the current POST /orders schema and shared signing test vectors.
findings.regression_test: Execute every published signing example against a local verifier generated from the current request schema.

findings.title: Authenticated curl examples omit the required API-key header
findings.surface: Revolut X authenticated endpoint curl examples
findings.claim: Authenticated endpoint examples include timestamp and signature but omit X-Revx-API-Key even though it is mandatory.

causal_memory.surface_scope: authenticated balance, configuration, market-data and order examples
causal_memory.state_scope: required authentication headers in generated curl examples

user_control.user_effect: The copy-paste example cannot satisfy the documented authentication contract.

findings.minimal_fix: Include X-Revx-API-Key in all authenticated curl examples and generate examples from operation security metadata.
findings.regression_test: Lint every authenticated operation example for all three required headers and every public operation for no auth header.

findings.title: BTC order-book example returns Ethereum levels
findings.surface: Revolut X public order-book response example
findings.claim: The documented BTC-USD request is paired with an ETH-labelled response sample.

causal_memory.state_scope: requested symbol versus response asset identity

user_control.user_effect: Generated tests and client examples can learn an impossible symbol-to-asset mapping.

findings.minimal_fix: Regenerate the sample with BTC-labelled levels or change the request symbol to ETH-USD.
findings.regression_test: Validate that every order-book sample base and quote asset match its path symbol.

findings.title: Crypto converter deep-link failure remains intermittent
findings.surface: Revolut public crypto amount and amount-to deep links
findings.claim: The amount and amount-to parameters can leave the conversion result empty while other page data loads.

counterfactual.required_next_sample: 20 cold browser loads with cache state, console and HAR

causal_memory.state_scope: amount parsing, rate response and converter render ordering

user_control.user_effect: The failure is plausible but a stable user-visible reproduction and triggering condition are not yet established.

findings.minimal_fix: Do not assign a product fix until the failed initialization path is reproduced with browser timing and network evidence.
findings.regression_test: Run 20 isolated cold navigations for amount and amount-to routes and correlate converter state with rate request completion and errors.

findings.title: Descending asks are an explicit contract, not a proven sorting bug
findings.claim: The descending ordering of asks is an accidental order-book sorting defect.

causal_memory.state_scope: documented sort direction only; no runtime best-price claim

user_control.user_effect: No user-control degradation is assigned to a behavior explicitly declared by the current contract.

findings.minimal_fix: Preserve this as negative causal memory and require runtime evidence before reopening the sorting claim.
findings.regression_test: Keep the contract assertion and separately test best bid and best ask semantics if runtime evidence becomes available.
